title: Published result frontmatter
description: Frontmatter for a published benchmark result. Every field a reader needs to identify what was run and against which recipe, and nothing that identifies a specific cluster or person. additionalProperties is false, so a document carrying extra fields is rejected rather than silently published.

scenario.description: Relative path to the scenario this result was produced from. A result is never separated from the recipe that produced it: a number without a reproducible recipe is not publishable. Checked to resolve.

authors.description: Org or team attribution. Not individual usernames: publishing one attributes work to a named person outside their employer without their say, and directory handles are not meaningful to an external reader.

bed.description: OPTIONAL short label distinguishing two results produced from the same scenario on different hardware. Deliberately opaque: a cluster's identity is not published, and its shape belongs in the referenced scenario's topology, where it is concrete and useful.
